title: MetaCurate: Evolving Curation Filters for High-Quality Agentic Coding Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.23134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning on agent trajectories is an effective way to improve coding agents, but selecting useful training examples requires more than identifying successful runs. A resolved patch may follow inefficient reasoning or unnecessary tool use, while a failed run may still contain useful intermediate steps. Training pipelines therefore rely on rules and qualitative assessments to filter trajectories, yet designing these filters typically requires substantial human expertise, and validating improvements through repeated training and evaluation is expensive. We introduce MetaCurate, a training-free framework that evolves executable trajectory curation filters using pairwise LLM judgments. Disagreements between the filter's rankings and the judge's preferences provide targeted feedback for jointly revising its rules, rubric, and aggregation policy. translated_title: MetaCurate：演化筛选过滤器以获取高质量智能体编程数据
translated_abstract: 对智能体轨迹进行监督微调是提升编程智能体能力的有效方法，但挑选有用的训练样本不仅仅是识别成功的运行结果。一个成功解决的补丁可能伴随着低效的推理或不必要的工具调用，而一次失败的运行中仍可能包含有用的中间步骤。因此，训练流程通常依赖规则和定性评估来过滤轨迹，然而设计这些过滤器往往需要大量的人类专业知识，并且通过反复训练和评估来验证改进的效果成本高昂。我们提出了 MetaCurate，这是一个无需训练的框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）的成对判断来自动演化可执行的轨迹筛选过滤器。过滤器排序与评判模型偏好之间的分歧为联合修订其规则、评分标准（rubric）和聚合策略提供了有针对性的反馈。最终得到的过滤器能够独立地对各条轨迹进行评分，因此成对比较……
tldr: MetaCurate 提出了一种无需训练的框架，通过大语言模型成对判断产生的反馈自动演化可执行的轨迹筛选过滤器，从而高效地为智能体编程训练挑选高质量数据样本。
en_tdlr: MetaCurate is a training-free framework that automatically evolves executable trajectory curation filters through feedback from pairwise LLM judgments, enabling efficient selection of high-quality training data for agentic coding.
